profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Web developer with 8 years of experience developing and designing websites and web applications.  Experienced in all stages of the development cycle for full stack web projects. Leverage analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills to create dynamic websites and apps.

Technologies:
HTML/CSS
Bootstrap
Javascript/ES6
jQuery
Git/Github
Ruby/Ruby on Rails
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
Node
Express
Angular
EmberJS
React

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Work on implementing new functionality and features to website using technologies such as:
HTML
CSS
Javascript
as well as a number of Javascript frameworks

positions.title: Senior Operator
positions.description:
Building and maintaining relationships with hotel partners.
Negotiating and waiving cancellations with hotel partners.
Sending inquiries, reservations, revisions, and cancellations in timely manner.
Managing cancellations/inventory of hotel rooms for re-use.
Working closely with other departments to ensure daily work was done efficiently.

positions.title: Reservation Agent
positions.description:
Built and maintained good relations with hotel sales persons, general managers, and owners.
Ability to maintain focus and prioritize objectives during hotel peak season.
Managed hotel room bookings, revisions, and cancellations in a quick and efficient manner.
